messages.subject: Max incoming connections?
parts:
Hi all,

I'd like to use R Shiny to implement sequential randomization in online survey experiments. Survey experiments typically take 10-15 minutes to complete, and I'd like to be able to have as many as a couple hundred people connected at the same time. What level of shinyapps account do I need to do that, if it's at all possible?

Thanks!

messages.author: edbcc711cdbb3da8
messages.subject: Re: [shinyapps-users] Max incoming connections?
parts:
Just to confirm Aaron, are you saying that for any given end user who is going through the survey they may take 10-15 minutes to fill it out? Or are you saying that there is a 10-15 minutes of computation per user?  
If it is the former, I would guess that you might be able to get it done at the lower plans as long as the computational needs of the survey are modest.  If you need more horse power you will want to be at the $39 plan at a minimum.  
The key thing to keep in mind is that as you add multiple instances or R workers you need to make sure that you are writing your survey results to a data store that handles concurrency well.
